name: 大白英语笔记·熟词僻义（2010 / 2012）
note: 来源：用户提供的笔记截图（2010 年 9 条 + 2012 年 28 条）。word/common/uncommon/en/cn 均为截图原内容；合并时优先于唐迟 deck。

rows.en: Perhaps the most far-reaching has been the inexorable decline in the scope and seriousness of their arts coverage.
rows.cn: 也许最深远的变化，就是报纸对艺术报道的广度和严肃性不断下降。

rows.uncommon: n. 评论；书评；影评；乐评
rows.en: Yet a considerable number of the most significant collections of criticism published in the 20th century consisted in large part of newspaper reviews.
rows.cn: 然而，20 世纪许多最重要的评论集，很大一部分都由报纸评论组成。

rows.en: The critics of major papers would write in detail and at length about the events they covered.
rows.cn: 各大报纸的评论家会详细而深入地撰写他们所报道的事件。

rows.uncommon: wear one's learning lightly = 学识渊博却不卖弄
rows.en: Even those reviewers who wore their learning lightly... could be trusted to know what they were about.
rows.cn: 即使是那些学识渊博却毫不炫耀的评论家，人们也相信他们真正懂行。

rows.en: These men believed in journalism as a calling.
rows.cn: 这些人把新闻工作视为一种使命（天职）。

rows.en: His vast body of writings on music is unknown save to specialists.
rows.cn: 除了专家之外，几乎没人了解他大量关于音乐的著作。

rows.uncommon: adj. 渺茫的；可能性很小的
rows.en: The prospect seems remote.
rows.cn: 这种可能性似乎十分渺茫。

rows.uncommon: adv. 急剧地；迅速地；一头扎进地
rows.en: The amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
rows.cn: 音乐评论中的业余传统一直在急剧衰退。

rows.en: The amateur tradition in music criticism has been in headlong retreat.
rows.cn: 音乐评论中的业余传统一直在急剧衰退。

rows.uncommon: v. 私下传播；暗示性地说明
rows.en: That whispered message... is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure.
rows.cn: 这种“悄悄话传递的信息”，就是我们听到“同辈压力”这个词时最典型的感受。

rows.en: half invitation and half forcing
rows.cn: 一半是邀请，一半是强迫。

rows.uncommon: v. 主张；认为（学术观点）
rows.en: Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force.
rows.cn: Rosenberg 认为同辈压力也可以是积极力量。

rows.en: an HIV-prevention initiative known as loveLife...
rows.cn: 一项名为 loveLife 的艾滋病预防计划。

rows.uncommon: phr. 着手；试图（系统行动）
rows.en: sets out to make cigarettes uncool.
rows.cn: 试图让吸烟变得“不酷”。

rows.uncommon: adj. 完全正确的；精准的
rows.en: Her critique... is spot-on.
rows.cn: 她的批评非常精准到位。

rows.en: fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits.
rows.cn: 未能调动同辈压力来促进健康行为。

rows.en: teenagers who desire nothing more than fitting in.
rows.cn: 青少年最渴望的就是融入群体。

rows.en: ought to take a page from advertisers.
rows.cn: 应该借鉴广告商的做法。

rows.uncommon: adj. 明显的；突出的（缺陷）
rows.en: The most glaring flaw of the social cure.
rows.cn: 社会疗法最明显的缺陷。

rows.en: The most glaring flaw.
rows.cn: 最明显的缺陷。

rows.en: peer groups exert enormous influence on our behavior.
rows.cn: 同辈群体对行为施加巨大影响。

rows.en: steer their activities in virtuous directions.
rows.cn: 引导其行为朝积极方向发展。

rows.en: in virtuous directions.
rows.cn: 朝积极正方向发展。

rows.uncommon: n. 方法；策略（行为手段）
rows.en: The tactic never really works.
rows.cn: 这种策略从未真正有效。

rows.uncommon: v. 精心策划；人为设计
rows.en: a social cure engineered from the outside.
rows.cn: 外部人为设计的社会疗法。

rows.en: A deal is a deal—except, apparently, when Entergy is involved.
rows.cn: 协议就是协议——但显然 Entergy 不这么认为。

rows.en: when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment.
rows.cn: 宣布违背长期承诺时。

rows.en: commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
rows.cn: 遵守州严格核监管规定的承诺。

rows.en: challenge the constitutionality of Vermont's rules.
rows.cn: 质疑佛蒙特州规定的合宪性。

rows.en: seek permission from state regulators.
rows.cn: 向州级监管机构申请许可。

rows.en: A string of accidents... raised serious questions.
rows.cn: 一系列事故引发了严重质疑。

rows.uncommon: n. 拼凑结构；不统一体系
rows.en: a patchwork regulations... if every state sets its own rules.
rows.cn: 各州规则各异，形成拼凑体系。

rows.en: that debate would be beside the point.
rows.cn: 那种争论将无关紧要。

rows.en: going to war with the state.
rows.cn: 与州政府对抗/交锋。

rows.en: it should keep in mind what promises... are worth.
rows.cn: 应牢记这些承诺的价值。

rows.uncommon: phr. 实施；开展（研究工作）
rows.en: the scientific methods they carry out their work.
rows.cn: 研究人员用科学方法开展研究工作。

rows.en: discovery claims should be thought of as...
rows.cn: 研究声明应被视为……
